author: Ankit
problem: Read N (1 to 100) and print pi truncated to N decimal places, keeping trailing zeros. The program has pi to 100 decimal places built in.
bug_description: Takes the first N characters of the pi string instead of N + 2, forgetting the '3.' at the front.

comments.accurate: Prints pi cut off after N decimal places
comments.wrong_behavior: Prints the first N characters of pi, counting the leading 3 and the point
comments.wrong_location: Digit count verified; check that the pi constant has all 100 decimals
